CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_financial_alerts(p_reference_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS TABLE(alert_type text, severity text, title text, description text, amount numeric, count integer, action_key text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;

  -- 1 entregas sem faturamento
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'DELIVERIES_PENDING_BILLING'::text, 'CRITICAL'::text,
         'Entregas confirmadas sem faturamento'::text,
         'Existem entregas concluídas que ainda não geraram conta a receber.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.quantidade_entregue * COALESCE(p.valor_litro_brl,0)),0)::numeric,
         COUNT(*)::int, 'entregas-nao-faturadas'::text
    FROM entregas e LEFT JOIN produtos p ON p.id = e.produto_id
   WHERE e.financial_status = 'PENDING_BILLING' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 2 recebimentos vencidos
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'OVERDUE_RECEIVABLES'::text, 'CRITICAL'::text,
         'Recebimentos vencidos'::text,
         'Parcelas a receber em atraso.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0)),0)::numeric,
         COUNT(*)::int, 'receber-vencidos'::text
    FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
   WHERE ari.due_date < p_reference_date AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 3 pagamentos vencidos
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'OVERDUE_PAYABLES'::text, 'CRITICAL'::text,
         'Pagamentos vencidos'::text,
         'Parcelas a pagar em atraso.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0)),0)::numeric,
         COUNT(*)::int, 'pagar-vencidos'::text
    FROM accounts_payable_installments api
   WHERE api.due_date < p_reference_date AND api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 4 NF-e pendente
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'PENDING_FISCAL_INVOICE'::text, 'HIGH'::text,
         'NF-e pendente'::text,
         'Contas a receber aguardando emissão de NF-e.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(total_amount),0)::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'nfe-pendente'::text
    FROM accounts_receivable
   WHERE fiscal_invoice_required = true AND fiscal_invoice_status = 'PENDING'
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 5 categorias sem DRE
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'UNCLASSIFIED_DRE'::text, 'MEDIUM'::text,
         'Categorias sem classificação DRE'::text,
         'Algumas categorias usadas em títulos não têm grupo DRE definido.'::text,
         0::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'categorias-dre'::text
    FROM financial_categories fc
   WHERE fc.dre_group IS NULL
     AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_receivable ar WHERE ar.category_id = fc.id)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_payable ap WHERE ap.category_id = fc.id))
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 6 recorrências com falha
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'RECURRING_FAILED'::text, 'HIGH'::text,
         'Recorrências com falha'::text,
         'Erros recentes na geração automática de títulos recorrentes.'::text,
         0::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'recorrencias'::text
    FROM recurring_generation_log WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND generated_at >= (p_reference_date - INTERVAL '30 days')
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 7 recorrências atrasadas
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'RECURRING_DUE'::text, 'HIGH'::text,
         'Recorrências atrasadas para geração'::text,
         'Modelos recorrentes ativos com geração pendente.'::text,
         0::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'recorrencias'::text
    FROM recurring_financial_templates
   WHERE active = true AND auto_generate = true
     AND next_generation_date IS NOT NULL AND next_generation_date < p_reference_date
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 8 contas sem centro de custo
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'MISSING_COST_CENTER'::text, 'MEDIUM'::text,
         'Contas sem centro de custo'::text,
         'Títulos financeiros sem centro de custo associado.'::text,
         0::numeric,
         ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts_receivable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED')
        + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts_payable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED'))::int,
         'centros-custo'::text
   WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_receivable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED')
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_payable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_financial_cashflow(p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_view_mode text DEFAULT 'PROJECTED'::text, p_group_by text DEFAULT 'DAY'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(period_label text, period_start date, expected_inflows numeric, expected_outflows numeric, realized_inflows numeric, realized_outflows numeric, projected_balance numeric, realized_balance numeric, accumulated_projected_balance numeric, accumulated_realized_balance numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_trunc text; v_fmt text;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  IF p_start_date IS NULL OR p_end_date IS NULL OR p_start_date > p_end_date THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Periodo invalido: informe datas inicial e final em ordem.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_group_by IS NULL OR upper(p_group_by) NOT IN ('DAY','WEEK','MONTH') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Agrupamento invalido.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_view_mode IS NULL OR upper(p_view_mode) NOT IN ('PROJECTED','REALIZED','COMPARATIVE') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Modo de visualizacao invalido.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  v_trunc := CASE upper(p_group_by) WHEN 'WEEK' THEN 'week' WHEN 'MONTH' THEN 'month' ELSE 'day' END;
  v_fmt := CASE upper(p_group_by) WHEN 'MONTH' THEN 'MM/YYYY' WHEN 'WEEK' THEN '"Sem" IW/IYYY' ELSE 'DD/MM' END;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH proj_in AS (
    SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, ari.due_date)::date b,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ari.status = 'PAID' THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0,ari.original_amount + COALESCE(ari.interest_amount,0) + COALESCE(ari.penalty_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0)) END) v
      FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
     WHERE ari.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND ari.status <> 'CANCELED'
     GROUP BY 1
  ), proj_out AS (
    SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, api.due_date)::date b,
           SUM(CASE WHEN api.status = 'PAID' THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0,api.original_amount + COALESCE(api.interest_amount,0) + COALESCE(api.penalty_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0)) END) v
      FROM accounts_payable_installments api
     WHERE api.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND api.status <> 'CANCELED'
     GROUP BY 1
  ), real_in AS (
    SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, rp.payment_date)::date b, SUM(rp.amount_received) v
      FROM receivable_payments rp
     WHERE rp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     GROUP BY 1
  ), real_out AS (
    SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, pp.payment_date)::date b, SUM(pp.amount_paid) v
      FROM payable_payments pp
     WHERE pp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     GROUP BY 1
  ), buckets AS (
    SELECT b FROM proj_in UNION SELECT b FROM proj_out
    UNION SELECT b FROM real_in UNION SELECT b FROM real_out
  ), combined AS (
    SELECT b.b AS bk,
           COALESCE(pi.v,0)::numeric ei, COALESCE(po.v,0)::numeric eo,
           COALESCE(ri.v,0)::numeric ri_v, COALESCE(ro.v,0)::numeric ro_v
      FROM buckets b
      LEFT JOIN proj_in pi ON pi.b = b.b
      LEFT JOIN proj_out po ON po.b = b.b
      LEFT JOIN real_in ri ON ri.b = b.b
      LEFT JOIN real_out ro ON ro.b = b.b
  )
  SELECT to_char(bk, v_fmt),
         bk,
         CASE WHEN upper(p_view_mode)='REALIZED' THEN 0 ELSE ei END,
         CASE WHEN upper(p_view_mode)='REALIZED' THEN 0 ELSE eo END,
         CASE WHEN upper(p_view_mode)='PROJECTED' THEN 0 ELSE ri_v END,
         CASE WHEN upper(p_view_mode)='PROJECTED' THEN 0 ELSE ro_v END,
         (ei - eo)::numeric,
         (ri_v - ro_v)::numeric,
         SUM(ei - eo) OVER (ORDER BY bk)::numeric,
         SUM(ri_v - ro_v) OVER (ORDER BY bk)::numeric
    FROM combined
   ORDER BY bk;
END $function$
functions.name: get_financial_cashflow

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_report_delinquency(_as_of date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS TABLE(installment_id uuid, customer_name text, description text, due_date date, amount numeric, balance numeric, days_overdue integer, customer_phone text, customer_email text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT i.id, COALESCE(c.nome, c.razao_social, '—'), ar.description, i.due_date, i.amount,
    i.amount - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(rp.amount_received) FROM receivable_payments rp
                         WHERE rp.installment_id = i.id AND rp.is_reversal=false),0),
    (_as_of - i.due_date)::int,
    COALESCE(c.contato_financeiro_telefone, c.telefone),
    COALESCE(c.contato_financeiro_email, c.email)
  FROM accounts_receivable_installments i
  JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = i.receivable_id
  LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.id = ar.cliente_id
  WHERE i.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND i.due_date < _as_of
  ORDER BY i.due_date;
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_report_deliveries_billing_status(_from date, _to date)
 RETURNS TABLE(delivery_id uuid, customer_name text, delivery_date date, total_value numeric, billed boolean, receivable_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;

  IF _from IS NULL OR _to IS NULL OR _to < _from THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Período inválido' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT e.id,
         COALESCE(c.nome, c.razao_social, '—'),
         COALESCE(e.entregue_em::date, e.data_saida),
         COALESCE(ar.total_amount, 0)::numeric,
         (ar.id IS NOT NULL),
         ar.id
  FROM entregas e
  JOIN clientes c ON c.id = e.cliente_id
  LEFT JOIN accounts_receivable ar
         ON ar.id = e.receivable_id
        AND ar.customer_id = e.cliente_id
        AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
  WHERE COALESCE(e.entregue_em::date, e.data_saida) BETWEEN _from AND _to
  ORDER BY COALESCE(e.entregue_em::date, e.data_saida) DESC, e.id;
END;$function$
functions.name: get_report_deliveries_billing_status

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_report_nfe_pending(_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(receivable_id uuid, customer_name text, description text, total_amount numeric, issue_date date, fiscal_invoice_status text, fiscal_invoice_required boolean, origin_type text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT ar.id, COALESCE(c.nome, c.razao_social, '—'), ar.description,
         ar.total_amount, ar.issue_date,
         COALESCE(ar.fiscal_invoice_status, 'PENDING'),
         COALESCE(ar.fiscal_invoice_required, false),
         COALESCE(ar.origin_type, 'MANUAL')
  FROM accounts_receivable ar
  LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.id = ar.customer_id
  WHERE ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
    AND (ar.fiscal_invoice_status = 'PENDING'
         OR (COALESCE(ar.fiscal_invoice_required,false)=true
             AND COALESCE(ar.fiscal_invoice_status,'PENDING') <> 'ISSUED'))
  ORDER BY ar.issue_date DESC NULLS LAST;
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_report_payables(_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(installment_id uuid, payable_id uuid, supplier text, description text, category text, due_date date, amount numeric, paid numeric, balance numeric, status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _from date := (_filters->>'from')::date;
        _to date := (_filters->>'to')::date;
        _status text := _filters->>'status';
BEGIN
  IF NOT is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT i.id, ap.id, COALESCE(ap.supplier_name,'—'), ap.description, fc.name,
         i.due_date, i.original_amount,
         COALESCE(i.paid_amount,0),
         i.original_amount - COALESCE(i.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(i.discount_amount,0),
         i.status
  FROM accounts_payable_installments i
  JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = i.payable_id
  LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ap.category_id
  WHERE (_from IS NULL OR i.due_date >= _from)
    AND (_to IS NULL OR i.due_date <= _to)
    AND (_status IS NULL OR i.status = _status)
    AND ap.status <> 'CANCELED'
  ORDER BY i.due_date;
END;$function$

         i.due_date, i.original_amount,
         COALESCE(i.received_amount,0),

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_active_user_cliente_access(_user_id uuid, _cliente_id uuid, _levels text[] DEFAULT ARRAY['read'::text, 'execute'::text, 'manage'::text])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF _user_id IS NULL OR _cliente_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;
  IF NOT public.fn_authz_uid_scope_ok(_user_id) THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;
  IF public.has_role(_user_id, 'administrador'::public.app_role) THEN
    RETURN true;
  END IF;
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM public.user_clientes uc
     WHERE uc.user_id = _user_id
       AND uc.cliente_id = _cliente_id
       AND uc.is_active = true
       AND uc.revoked_at IS NULL
       AND (uc.valid_from IS NULL OR uc.valid_from <= now())
       AND (uc.valid_until IS NULL OR uc.valid_until >= now())
       AND uc.access_level::text = ANY(_levels)
  );
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(p_user_id uuid, p_partner_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p_user_id)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=p.organization_id
 JOIN public.partner_users pu ON pu.user_id=p.user_id
 JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id=pu.partner_id
 JOIN public.organizations owner ON owner.id=pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
 WHERE p.user_id=p_user_id AND pa.id=p_partner_id AND p.ativo AND o.ativo AND o.status='ativa'
 AND owner.ativo AND owner.status='ativa' AND pa.ativo AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
 AND p.organization_id=pu.tenant_id AND pu.tenant_id=owner.id
 AND (o.partner_account_id IS NULL OR o.partner_account_id=pa.id)
 AND pu.revoked_at IS NULL AND pu.valid_from<=now())
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id=p_user_id)=1
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=p_user_id AND role IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico'))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=p_user_id AND role NOT IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico','cliente_produtor'));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_aging(p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(faixa text, qtd_titulos integer, valor numeric, parceiros integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
BEGIN
  -- H7O: autorização explícita (antes: filtro h7n_guarded devolvia 0 linhas).
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501',
      HINT = 'H7O: aging B2B restrito a administrador/gestor/financeiro/gestor_comercial/administrativo.';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT ar.partner_id, ari.id,
           (ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount) AS saldo,
           GREATEST(0, (current_date - ari.due_date)) AS dias
    FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    WHERE ar.origin_type = 'B2B_ORDER'
      AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
      AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ar.partner_id = p_partner_id)
  ), faixas AS (
    SELECT CASE
             WHEN dias <= 30 THEN '0-30'
             WHEN dias <= 60 THEN '31-60'
             WHEN dias <= 90 THEN '61-90'
             ELSE '90+'
           END AS faixa, partner_id, saldo
    FROM base
  )
  SELECT faixa, COUNT(*)::int, COALESCE(SUM(saldo),0), COUNT(DISTINCT partner_id)::int
  FROM faixas GROUP BY faixa
  ORDER BY CASE faixa WHEN '0-30' THEN 1 WHEN '31-60' THEN 2 WHEN '61-90' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END;
END
$function$
functions.name: rpc_b2b_aging

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_aging_detalhado(p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(faixa text, qtd_titulos integer, valor numeric, qtd_parceiros integer, pct_carteira numeric, valor_medio_parceiro numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_total numeric;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT ar.partner_id, ari.id AS inst_id,
      (ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount) AS saldo,
      GREATEST(0, (CURRENT_DATE - ari.due_date)) AS dias_atraso
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    WHERE ar.origin_type = 'B2B_ORDER'
      AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ar.partner_id = p_partner_id)
      AND (p_from IS NULL OR ar.issue_date >= p_from)
      AND (p_to   IS NULL OR ar.issue_date <= p_to)
      AND (p_status IS NULL OR ari.status = p_status)
  ),
  classed AS (
    SELECT *,
      CASE
        WHEN dias_atraso <= 30 THEN '0-30'
        WHEN dias_atraso <= 60 THEN '31-60'
        WHEN dias_atraso <= 90 THEN '61-90'
        ELSE '90+'
      END AS bucket
    FROM base
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(saldo),0) INTO v_total FROM classed;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT ar.partner_id,
      (ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount) AS saldo,
      GREATEST(0, (CURRENT_DATE - ari.due_date)) AS dias_atraso
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    WHERE ar.origin_type = 'B2B_ORDER'
      AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ar.partner_id = p_partner_id)
      AND (p_from IS NULL OR ar.issue_date >= p_from)
      AND (p_to   IS NULL OR ar.issue_date <= p_to)
      AND (p_status IS NULL OR ari.status = p_status)
  ),
  classed AS (
    SELECT *,
      CASE
        WHEN dias_atraso <= 30 THEN '0-30'
        WHEN dias_atraso <= 60 THEN '31-60'
        WHEN dias_atraso <= 90 THEN '61-90'
        ELSE '90+'
      END AS bucket
    FROM base
  )
  SELECT
    b AS faixa,
    COALESCE(COUNT(c.*),0)::int AS qtd_titulos,
    COALESCE(SUM(c.saldo),0)::numeric AS valor,
    COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT c.partner_id),0)::int AS qtd_parceiros,
    CASE WHEN v_total > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(c.saldo),0)/v_total)*100,2) ELSE 0 END AS pct_carteira,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.partner_id) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(c.saldo),0)/COUNT(DISTINCT c.partner_id),2) ELSE 0 END AS valor_medio_parceiro
  FROM (VALUES ('0-30'),('31-60'),('61-90'),('90+')) AS f(b)
  LEFT JOIN classed c ON c.bucket = f.b
  GROUP BY f.b
  ORDER BY CASE f.b WHEN '0-30' THEN 1 WHEN '31-60' THEN 2 WHEN '61-90' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END;
END;$function$
functions.name: rpc_b2b_aging_detalhado

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_carteira_kpis(p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT ar.id, ar.issue_date, ari.original_amount, ari.received_amount, ari.due_date, ari.status, ari.paid_at
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    WHERE ar.origin_type='B2B_ORDER'
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'carteira_total', COALESCE(SUM(original_amount),0),
    'carteira_recebida', COALESCE(SUM(received_amount),0),
    'carteira_vencida', COALESCE(SUM(original_amount - received_amount) FILTER (WHERE due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0),
    'carteira_aberto', COALESCE(SUM(original_amount - received_amount) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0),
    'receita_mes', COALESCE(SUM(received_amount) FILTER (WHERE paid_at >= date_trunc('month',now())),0),
    'receita_ano', COALESCE(SUM(received_amount) FILTER (WHERE paid_at >= date_trunc('year',now())),0),
    'inadimplencia_pct', CASE WHEN SUM(original_amount) > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(original_amount - received_amount) FILTER (WHERE due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0)/SUM(original_amount))*100,2) ELSE 0 END,
    'prazo_medio_recebimento', ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (paid_at - issue_date))/86400) FILTER (WHERE paid_at IS NOT NULL),0)::numeric,2),
    'ticket_medio', CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT id) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(original_amount),0)/COUNT(DISTINCT id),2) ELSE 0 END
  ) INTO v
  FROM base
  WHERE (p_from IS NULL OR issue_date >= p_from) AND (p_to IS NULL OR issue_date <= p_to);
  RETURN v;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_executive_alerts()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  WITH credit AS (
    SELECT pa.id, pa.nome_fantasia, pa.razao_social, pfs.credit_limit,
      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount)
        FROM accounts_receivable ar
        JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
        WHERE ar.origin_type='B2B_ORDER' AND ar.partner_id = pa.id
          AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0) AS aberto
    FROM partner_accounts pa
    LEFT JOIN partner_financial_settings pfs ON pfs.partner_id = pa.id
    WHERE pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(pfs.credit_limit,0) > 0
  ),
  classed AS (
    SELECT id, COALESCE(nome_fantasia, razao_social) AS nome, credit_limit, aberto,
      ROUND((aberto/credit_limit)*100,2) AS pct
    FROM credit
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'acima_80', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('partner_id',id,'nome',nome,'pct',pct,'aberto',aberto,'limite',credit_limit))
                 FROM classed WHERE pct >= 80 AND pct < 90),
    'acima_90', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('partner_id',id,'nome',nome,'pct',pct,'aberto',aberto,'limite',credit_limit))
                 FROM classed WHERE pct >= 90),
    'bloqueados', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('partner_id',po.partner_id,'numero',po.numero))
                   FROM partner_orders po WHERE po.status = 'aguardando_aprovacao_credito'),
    'com_vencidos', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('partner_id',prs.partner_id,'vencidos',prs.titulos_vencidos,'dias',prs.dias_medio_atraso))
                     FROM partner_risk_scores prs WHERE prs.titulos_vencidos > 0),
    'score_critico', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('partner_id',prs.partner_id,'score',prs.score))
                      FROM partner_risk_scores prs WHERE prs.risk_level = 'critico'),
    'receita_em_risco', (rpc_b2b_revenue_forecast(NULL)->>'em_risco')::numeric
  ) INTO v;
  RETURN v;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_partner_profitability(p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(partner_id uuid, partner_name text, total_comprado numeric, total_recebido numeric, total_aberto numeric, ticket_medio numeric, qtd_pedidos integer, prazo_medio_pgto numeric, inadimplencia_pct numeric, risk_score integer, risk_level text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
BEGIN
  -- H7O: autorização explícita (antes: filtro h7n_guarded devolvia 0 linhas).
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501',
      HINT = 'H7O: rentabilidade B2B restrita a administrador/gestor/financeiro/gestor_comercial/administrativo.';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH pedidos AS (
    SELECT po.partner_id, COUNT(*) AS qtd, SUM(po.total) AS total
    FROM partner_orders po
    WHERE po.status NOT IN ('cancelado','reprovado','rascunho')
      AND (p_from IS NULL OR po.created_at >= p_from)
      AND (p_to   IS NULL OR po.created_at <= (p_to + 1))
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR po.partner_id = p_partner_id)
    GROUP BY po.partner_id
  ),
  recebidos AS (
    SELECT ar.partner_id,
      SUM(ari.received_amount) AS rec,
      SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount) FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')) AS aberto,
      AVG(CASE WHEN ari.paid_at IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ari.paid_at - ar.issue_date))/86400 END) AS prazo_med,
      SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount) FILTER (WHERE ari.due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')) AS vencido
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    WHERE ar.origin_type='B2B_ORDER'
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ar.partner_id = p_partner_id)
    GROUP BY ar.partner_id
  )
  SELECT pa.id, COALESCE(pa.nome_fantasia, pa.razao_social),
    COALESCE(p.total,0),
    COALESCE(r.rec,0),
    COALESCE(r.aberto,0),
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.qtd,0) > 0 THEN ROUND(p.total/p.qtd,2) ELSE 0 END,
    COALESCE(p.qtd,0)::int,
    ROUND(COALESCE(r.prazo_med,0)::numeric,2),
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.total,0) > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(r.vencido,0)/p.total)*100,2) ELSE 0 END,
    COALESCE(prs.score,0),
    COALESCE(prs.risk_level,'baixo')
  FROM partner_accounts pa
  LEFT JOIN pedidos p ON p.partner_id = pa.id
  LEFT JOIN recebidos r ON r.partner_id = pa.id
  LEFT JOIN partner_risk_scores prs ON prs.partner_id = pa.id
  WHERE pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR pa.id = p_partner_id)
    AND (p.qtd IS NOT NULL OR r.rec IS NOT NULL)
  ORDER BY COALESCE(p.total,0) DESC;
END
$function$
functions.name: rpc_b2b_partner_profitability

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_revenue_forecast(p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  WITH conf AS (
    SELECT
      SUM(CASE WHEN ari.due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 30 THEN ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount ELSE 0 END) AS c30,
      SUM(CASE WHEN ari.due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 60 THEN ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount ELSE 0 END) AS c60,
      SUM(CASE WHEN ari.due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 90 THEN ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount ELSE 0 END) AS c90
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    WHERE ar.origin_type='B2B_ORDER' AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ar.partner_id = p_partner_id)
  ),
  proj AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) AS p30
    FROM partner_orders WHERE receivable_generated = false
      AND status IN ('aprovado','em_producao','produzido','aguardando_entrega','em_separacao','enviado','entregue')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR partner_id = p_partner_id)
  ),
  risk AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) AS r
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    LEFT JOIN partner_risk_scores prs ON prs.partner_id = ar.partner_id
    WHERE ar.origin_type='B2B_ORDER' AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
      AND (ari.due_date < CURRENT_DATE OR COALESCE(prs.risk_level,'baixo')='critico')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ar.partner_id = p_partner_id)
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'confirmada_30', COALESCE((SELECT c30 FROM conf),0),
    'confirmada_60', COALESCE((SELECT c60 FROM conf),0),
    'confirmada_90', COALESCE((SELECT c90 FROM conf),0),
    'projetada', COALESCE((SELECT p30 FROM proj),0),
    'em_risco', COALESCE((SELECT r FROM risk),0)
  ) INTO v;
  RETURN v;
END;$function$
functions.name: rpc_b2b_revenue_forecast

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_portal_partner_financial()
 RETURNS TABLE(partner_order_id uuid, numero text, receivable_id uuid, total numeric, vencimento date, financial_status text, payment_method text, ar_status text, installments jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

AS $function$

BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    po.id, po.numero, ar.id, po.total, po.payment_due_date, po.financial_status, po.payment_method, ar.status,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(

  WHERE po.partner_id IN (SELECT partner_id FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id = v_uid)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_portal_partner_financial(p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(partner_order_id uuid, numero text, receivable_id uuid, total numeric, vencimento date, financial_status text, payment_method text, ar_status text, installments jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_is_staff boolean := (has_role(v_uid, 'administrador'::app_role) OR has_role(v_uid, 'gestor_comercial'::app_role));
  v_filter_partner uuid;
BEGIN
  IF p_partner_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF NOT v_is_staff THEN
      -- Parceiro só pode ver o próprio; ignora tentativa de simular
      v_filter_partner := NULL;
    ELSE
      v_filter_partner := p_partner_id;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    po.id, po.numero, ar.id, po.total, po.payment_due_date, po.financial_status, po.payment_method, ar.status,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'numero', i.installment_number, 'vencimento', i.due_date,
        'valor', i.original_amount, 'recebido', i.received_amount, 'status', i.status
      ) ORDER BY i.installment_number)
      FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments i WHERE i.receivable_id = ar.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  FROM public.partner_orders po
  JOIN public.partner_order_financial_links l ON l.partner_order_id = po.id
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = l.receivable_id
  WHERE
    (
      v_filter_partner IS NOT NULL AND po.partner_id = v_filter_partner
    )
    OR (
      v_filter_partner IS NULL AND po.partner_id IN (SELECT partner_id FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id = v_uid)
    )
  ORDER BY po.created_at DESC;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.h15_fiscal_audit_access(p_table text, p_record uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF public.h15_actor_organization() IS NULL OR p_record IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  RETURN CASE p_table
    WHEN 'company_fiscal_settings' THEN public.h15_company_access(p_record)
    WHEN 'fiscal_invoices' THEN public.h15_invoice_access(p_record)
    WHEN 'fiscal_events' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.fiscal_events e WHERE e.id=p_record AND public.h15_invoice_access(e.fiscal_invoice_id))
    WHEN 'fiscal_xml_runs' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.fiscal_xml_runs r WHERE r.id=p_record AND public.h15_invoice_access(r.fiscal_invoice_id))
    WHEN 'fiscal_sefaz_transmissions' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.fiscal_sefaz_transmissions t WHERE t.id=p_record AND public.h15_invoice_access(t.fiscal_invoice_id))
    WHEN 'fiscal_protocoled_documents' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.fiscal_protocoled_documents d WHERE d.id=p_record AND public.h15_invoice_access(d.fiscal_invoice_id))
    WHEN 'fiscal_certificates' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.fiscal_certificates c WHERE c.id=p_record AND public.h15_company_access(c.company_settings_id))

  END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.saas_feature_override_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'saas_history_immutable: exceções não podem ser apagadas' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND (
    NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.organization_id
    OR NEW.feature_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.feature_id
    OR NEW.mode IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.mode
    OR NEW.limit_value IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.limit_value
    OR NEW.starts_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.starts_at
    OR NEW.ends_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ends_at
    OR NEW.reason IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reason
    OR NEW.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by
    OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
    OR OLD.ended_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.ended_at IS NULL
    OR NEW.ended_by IS NULL
    OR NULLIF(btrim(NEW.end_reason), '') IS NULL
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'saas_history_immutable: somente encerramento auditado é permitido' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.entitlements_for_user(_uid uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(module_key text, feature_key text, limit_value numeric, config jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  WITH actor AS (
    SELECT p.organization_id
    FROM public.profiles p
    JOIN public.organizations org
      ON org.id = p.organization_id
     AND org.ativo IS TRUE
    WHERE p.user_id = _uid
      AND p.ativo IS TRUE
      AND p.organization_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY p.created_at, p.organization_id
    LIMIT 1
  ), current_subscription AS (
    SELECT s.organization_id, s.plan_version_id
    FROM public.organization_subscriptions s
    JOIN actor a ON a.organization_id = s.organization_id
    JOIN public.saas_plan_versions v
      ON v.id = s.plan_version_id
     AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED'
     AND v.effective_from <= now()
     AND (v.effective_to IS NULL OR v.effective_to > now())
    WHERE s.plan_version_id IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        s.status = 'ACTIVE'
        OR (s.status = 'TRIAL' AND s.trial_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND s.trial_ends_at > now())
      )
      AND (s.cancel_at IS NULL OR s.cancel_at > now())
    ORDER BY s.started_at DESC, s.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ), candidates AS (
    SELECT f.id AS feature_id, f.module_id, f.key AS feature_key,
           vf.enabled AS base_enabled, vf.limit_value AS base_limit, vf.config AS base_config
    FROM current_subscription s
    JOIN public.saas_plan_version_features vf ON vf.plan_version_id = s.plan_version_id
    JOIN public.saas_features f ON f.id = vf.feature_id AND f.active IS TRUE
    UNION
    SELECT f.id, f.module_id, f.key, false, NULL::numeric, NULL::jsonb
    FROM current_subscription s
    JOIN public.organization_feature_overrides o ON o.organization_id = s.organization_id
    JOIN public.saas_features f ON f.id = o.feature_id AND f.active IS TRUE
    WHERE o.ended_at IS NULL
      AND o.starts_at <= now()
      AND (o.ends_at IS NULL OR o.ends_at > now())
  ), effective AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.feature_id)
      c.feature_id, c.module_id, c.feature_key,
      CASE
        WHEN o.mode = 'REVOKE' THEN false
        WHEN o.mode = 'GRANT' THEN true
        ELSE c.base_enabled
      END AS enabled,
      CASE
        WHEN o.mode = 'GRANT' THEN o.limit_value
        WHEN o.mode = 'REVOKE' THEN NULL::numeric
        ELSE c.base_limit
      END AS effective_limit,
      c.base_config AS effective_config
    FROM candidates c
    CROSS JOIN current_subscription s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT x.mode, x.limit_value
      FROM public.organization_feature_overrides x
      WHERE x.organization_id = s.organization_id
        AND x.feature_id = c.feature_id
        AND x.ended_at IS NULL
        AND x.starts_at <= now()
        AND (x.ends_at IS NULL OR x.ends_at > now())
      ORDER BY x.created_at DESC, x.id DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) o ON true
    ORDER BY c.feature_id
  )
  SELECT m.key::text, e.feature_key::text, e.effective_limit::numeric, e.effective_config
  FROM effective e
  JOIN public.saas_modules m ON m.id = e.module_id AND m.active IS TRUE
  WHERE e.enabled IS TRUE
  ORDER BY m.key, e.feature_key
$function$
functions.name: entitlements_for_user

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_actor_scope(_uid uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(profile_ok boolean, org_partner uuid, user_partner uuid, user_partner_count integer, partner_valid boolean, has_catalog boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH pr AS (
    SELECT o.partner_account_id
      FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = p.organization_id
     WHERE p.user_id = _uid AND p.ativo = true AND o.ativo = true AND o.status = 'ativa'
     LIMIT 1
  ), pu AS (
    SELECT count(*)::int c, min(partner_id::text)::uuid pid
      FROM public.partner_users
     WHERE user_id = _uid AND revoked_at IS NULL
  ), valid AS (
    -- Caminho fornecedor: vínculo só resolve o parceiro com a cadeia completa
    -- perfil→organização→tenant→proprietário comprovada no servidor.
    SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT c FROM pu) = 1
                 AND public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(_uid, (SELECT pid FROM pu))
                 AND EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1
                     FROM public.partner_users puv
                     JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = puv.partner_id
                     JOIN public.organizations owner ON owner.id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
                     JOIN public.profiles pf ON pf.user_id = puv.user_id
                     JOIN public.organizations porg ON porg.id = pf.organization_id
                    WHERE puv.user_id = _uid
                      AND puv.partner_id = (SELECT pid FROM pu)
                      AND puv.revoked_at IS NULL
                      AND (puv.valid_from IS NULL OR puv.valid_from <= now())
                      AND pf.ativo = true
                      AND porg.ativo = true AND porg.status = 'ativa'
                      AND pf.organization_id = puv.tenant_id
                      AND puv.tenant_id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
                      AND pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
                      AND owner.ativo = true AND owner.status = 'ativa'
                 )
              THEN (SELECT pid FROM pu) END AS pid
  )
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr),
         -- Organização com parceiro explícito prevalece; sem ela, o vínculo autorizado
         -- validado resolve o parceiro. Se ambos existirem e divergirem, org_partner
         -- permanece o da organização e os consumidores negam por mismatch.
         COALESCE((SELECT partner_account_id FROM pr), (SELECT pid FROM valid)),
         (SELECT pid FROM valid),
         (SELECT c FROM pu),
         CASE WHEN (SELECT partner_account_id FROM pr) IS NOT NULL
              THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = pr.partner_account_id
                            WHERE pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL)
              ELSE (SELECT pid FROM valid) IS NOT NULL END,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.entitlements_for_user(_uid) e WHERE e.feature_key = 'catalogo_precos');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.notification_outbox_closed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.template_chave='tenant_smtp_diagnostic_v1' AND NEW.status='processing' AND NEW.max_attempts=1 AND NEW.lease_expires_at IS NULL
 AND NEW.attempts=1 AND NEW.canal='email' AND NEW.recipient_cliente_id IS NULL AND NEW.recipient_hash IS NULL
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.tenant_smtp_test_insert_tickets t
 JOIN public.comunicacao_eventos e ON e.id=NEW.event_id
 WHERE t.outbox_id=NEW.id AND t.tx=txid_current() AND NEW.recipient_user_id=t.actor_id
 AND platform_private.tenant_smtp_test_actor(t.actor_id)=t.organization_id
 AND e.source_type='tenant_smtp_diagnostic_v1' AND e.source_id=t.organization_id AND e.created_by=t.actor_id
 AND e.event_key='tenant.smtp.diagnostic' AND e.status='processed') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 IF NEW.template_chave='solicitacao_atribuida_consultor_v1' AND NEW.status='processing' AND NEW.max_attempts=1 AND NEW.lease_expires_at IS NULL
 AND NEW.attempts=0 AND NEW.canal='email' AND NEW.recipient_cliente_id IS NULL AND NEW.recipient_hash IS NULL AND NEW.locked_by='tenant_smtp_lane'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.tenant_smtp_dispatch_insert_tickets t
 JOIN public.comunicacao_eventos e ON e.id=NEW.event_id
 WHERE t.outbox_id=NEW.id AND t.tx=txid_current() AND NEW.recipient_user_id=t.recipient_user_id
 AND platform_private.tenant_smtp_lane_recipient(t.organization_id,t.recipient_user_id) IS NOT NULL
 AND e.source_type='portal_solicitacoes' AND e.source_id=t.source_id
 AND e.event_key='tenant.smtp.solicitacao_atribuida' AND e.status='processed') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$
functions.name: notification_outbox_closed

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_commercial_context()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE u uuid:=auth.uid(); org uuid; pid uuid; rs text[]; result jsonb; BEGIN
 org:=public.h15_actor_organization();
 SELECT partner_id INTO pid FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id=u;
 IF NOT public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(u,pid) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT array_agg(role::text ORDER BY role::text) INTO rs FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=u;
 result:=jsonb_build_object('contract','C2_MULTIPROFILE_V1','actor_id',u,'tenant_id',org,
 'organization_id',org,'partner_id',pid,'commercial_owner_organization_id',org,'external_roles',rs,
 'role',CASE WHEN 'parceiro_b2b'=ANY(rs) THEN 'parceiro_b2b' ELSE 'parceiro_b2b_tecnico' END,
 'papel',CASE WHEN 'parceiro_b2b'=ANY(rs) THEN 'gestor' ELSE 'tecnico' END,'mode','commercial_owner',
 'manager', 'parceiro_b2b'=ANY(rs),'technician','parceiro_b2b_tecnico'=ANY(rs),
 'producer_links_valid',platform_private.c2_producer_links(u,org),
 'profile_stamp',(SELECT updated_at FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id=u),
 'link_version',(SELECT version FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id=u));
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.lab_item_is_manufacturable(p_product_id uuid, p_microorganism_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean

 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER

AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    -- Duas referências na mesma linha são ambíguas e falham fechadas. Isso impede que

    WHEN p_microorganism_id IS NOT NULL THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.microrganismos m WHERE m.id=p_microorganism_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.guard_manual_lot_write_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
 p public.programacao_producao%ROWTYPE;
 old_manual boolean:=false;
 old_programacao uuid;
 org uuid;
BEGIN
 -- Lock old/new parents in deterministic order. An UPDATE cannot escape the
 -- manual fence by changing programacao_id to onfarm or NULL.
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN old_programacao:=OLD.programacao_id; END IF;
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.programacao_producao
 WHERE id=NEW.programacao_id OR id=old_programacao
 ORDER BY id FOR SHARE;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN
  SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.programacao_producao
    WHERE id=OLD.programacao_id AND ordem_servico_id IS NOT NULL) INTO old_manual;
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO p FROM public.programacao_producao WHERE id=NEW.programacao_id;
 IF old_manual OR p.ordem_servico_id IS NOT NULL OR p.id IS NULL THEN
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND old_manual THEN
   org:=platform_private.h15_actor_organization();
   IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND org IS NOT NULL AND public.technical_actor_ready(auth.uid()) IS TRUE
    AND (public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador') OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'gestor') OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'producao')) IS TRUE
    AND p.id IS NOT NULL AND p.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NULL AND p.organization_id=org AND NEW.organization_id=org AND OLD.organization_id=org
    AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-'status'-'updated_at') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'status'-'updated_at')
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.ordens_servico o JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=o.cliente_id
     WHERE o.id=p.ordem_servico_id AND o.organization_id=org AND c.organization_id=org AND o.status::text='em_cq'
     AND o.partner_order_id IS NULL AND o.partner_order_item_id IS NULL AND o.origem IS DISTINCT FROM 'b2b')
    AND ((OLD.status::text='em_producao' AND NEW.status::text='aguardando_cq' AND p.status::text='aguardando_cq'
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.authz_tickets WHERE txid=txid_current() AND scope='manual_cq_send_v1' AND target=NEW.id))
     OR (OLD.status::text='aguardando_cq' AND NEW.status::text IN ('aprovado','reprovado') AND p.status::text='aguardando_cq'
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.authz_tickets WHERE txid=txid_current() AND scope='manual_cq_'||NEW.status::text||'_v1' AND target=NEW.id)
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.controle_qualidade c WHERE c.lote_id=NEW.id AND c.organization_id=org AND c.resultado::text=NEW.status::text
      AND c.responsavel='DADOS FICTICIOS SEM VALOR COMERCIAL' AND c.ph IS NOT NULL AND c.concentracao IS NOT NULL)))
   THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  END IF;

  -- No JWT/GUC/current_user/service-role escape: only the reviewed insert RPC
  -- can issue this private, target-specific ticket; it removes it after INSERT.
  org:=platform_private.h15_actor_organization();
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' OR org IS NULL OR auth.uid() IS NULL
   OR public.technical_actor_ready(auth.uid()) IS NOT TRUE
   OR p.id IS NULL OR p.ordem_servico_id IS NULL OR p.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NOT NULL
   OR p.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM org OR NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM org
   OR p.produto_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.produto_id OR p.microrganismo_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.microrganismo_id
   OR p.status::text IS DISTINCT FROM 'aguardando' OR NEW.status::text IS DISTINCT FROM 'em_producao'
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.ordens_servico o JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=o.cliente_id
     WHERE o.id=p.ordem_servico_id AND o.organization_id=org AND c.organization_id=org
     AND o.status::text='programada' AND o.partner_order_id IS NULL AND o.partner_order_item_id IS NULL
     AND o.origem IS DISTINCT FROM 'b2b')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.authz_tickets
     WHERE txid=pg_catalog.txid_current() AND scope='manual_lot_insert_v1' AND target=NEW.id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'MANUAL_LOT_WRITE_REQUIRES_REVIEWED_RPC' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
functions.name: guard_manual_lot_write_v1

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_own_obligations_owner(p_partner_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE u uuid:=auth.uid(); s record; owner uuid;
BEGIN
 IF u IS NULL OR NOT platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(u)
  OR NOT public.has_role(u,'parceiro_b2b') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'own_finance_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF NOT public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(u,p_partner_id) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'own_finance_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT pa.commercial_owner_organization_id INTO owner FROM public.partner_accounts pa
 JOIN public.partner_users pu ON pu.partner_id=pa.id
 JOIN public.profiles pf ON pf.user_id=pu.user_id
 JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
 WHERE pa.id=p_partner_id AND pu.user_id=u
 AND pu.revoked_at IS NULL AND pu.valid_from<=now()
 AND pf.ativo AND o.ativo AND o.status='ativa' AND pa.ativo AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
 AND pf.organization_id=pu.tenant_id AND pu.tenant_id=o.id
 AND public.h15_actor_organization()=o.id;
 IF owner IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.entitlements_for_user(u) e WHERE e.feature_key='pedidos_b2b')
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.entitlements_for_user(u) e WHERE e.feature_key='contas_receber') THEN

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_own_obligations(p_partner_id uuid, p_before timestamp with time zone, p_before_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE owner uuid; rows jsonb;
BEGIN
 owner:=platform_private.b2b_own_obligations_owner(p_partner_id);
 IF (p_before IS NULL) <> (p_before_id IS NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_cursor' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(q.value ORDER BY q.created_at DESC,q.id DESC),'[]'::jsonb) INTO rows FROM (
 SELECT ar.id,ar.created_at,jsonb_build_object('id',ar.id,'order_id',po.id,'numero',po.numero,
 'created_at',ar.created_at,'total',ar.total_amount,'status',ar.status,
 'installments',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',i.id,'numero',i.installment_number,
 'vencimento',i.due_date,'valor',i.original_amount,'recebido',i.received_amount,'status',i.status)
 ORDER BY i.installment_number,i.id) FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments i WHERE i.receivable_id=ar.id),'[]'::jsonb)) value
 FROM public.partner_orders po JOIN public.partner_order_financial_links l ON l.partner_order_id=po.id
 JOIN public.accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id=l.receivable_id
 WHERE po.partner_id=p_partner_id AND l.partner_id=p_partner_id AND ar.partner_id=p_partner_id
 AND ar.origin_type='B2B_ORDER' AND ar.origin_id=po.id AND ar.organization_id=owner
 -- A title with an ambiguous order/link or foreign/unowned installment is not projected.
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_order_financial_links x WHERE x.receivable_id=ar.id)=1
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_order_financial_links x WHERE x.partner_order_id=po.id)=1
 AND ar.total_amount>=0 AND ar.total_amount::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments i WHERE i.receivable_id=ar.id
  AND (i.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM owner OR i.original_amount IS NULL OR i.received_amount IS NULL
   OR i.original_amount<0 OR i.received_amount<0 OR i.original_amount::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
   OR i.received_amount::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')))
 AND (p_before IS NULL OR (ar.created_at,ar.id)<(p_before,p_before_id))
 ORDER BY ar.created_at DESC,ar.id DESC LIMIT 50
 ) q;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('contract','C2_OWN_OBLIGATIONS_V1','partner_id',p_partner_id,
 'rows',rows,'limit',50,'documents_enabled',false);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2p1_settings_fence()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR NOT platform_private.c2p1_settings_allowed(NEW.partner_id,true)
 OR NOT platform_private.has_ticket('c2p1_settings_write',NEW.partner_id) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_SETTINGS_WRITE_CLOSED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id OR NEW.partner_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.partner_id
 OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.payment_methods WHERE active IS TRUE AND name=NEW.default_payment_method)<>1
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_PAYMENT_METHOD_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 IF NEW.credit_limit::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR NEW.credit_limit<0
 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_1::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_2::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_1 NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_2 NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100
 OR NEW.credit_alert_threshold_1>NEW.credit_alert_threshold_2
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_FINANCIAL_VALUES_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_accounting_pending_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- While pending, only commercial review/quote, rejection or cancellation are possible: no approval,
 -- credit decision, economics seal, receivable, production, NF or delivery.
 -- INSERT: the canonical create may land in em_analise_comercial, aguardando_cotacao or (insufficient credit)
 -- aguardando_aprovacao_credito; nothing operational/financial may be set at creation.
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
  IF NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1' AND (
     NEW.status::text NOT IN ('em_analise_comercial','aguardando_cotacao','aguardando_aprovacao_credito')
     OR NEW.ready_for_production IS TRUE OR NEW.receivable_generated IS TRUE OR NEW.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.credit_approved_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.approved_at IS NOT NULL) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_ACCOUNTING_PENDING' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 IF OLD.c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1'
    AND NEW.c2_external_origin_snapshot->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1' THEN
  -- aguardando_aprovacao_credito may only stay as is (no hidden credit decision) or leave to cancel/reject.
  IF NOT (NEW.status::text IN ('em_analise_comercial','aguardando_cotacao','cancelado','reprovado')
          OR (NEW.status=OLD.status AND OLD.status::text='aguardando_aprovacao_credito'))
     OR (OLD.status::text='aguardando_aprovacao_credito' AND NEW.status::text IN ('em_analise_comercial','aguardando_cotacao'))
     OR NEW.ready_for_production IS TRUE OR NEW.receivable_generated IS TRUE OR NEW.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL
     OR NEW.credit_approved_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_approved_at OR NEW.approved_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_at
     -- review e1e9aa2f: no credit/financial decision field may advance by any privileged path while pending.
     OR NEW.credit_approved_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_approved_by OR NEW.credit_approval_notes IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_approval_notes
     OR NEW.approved_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_by
     -- review 61b28: the canonical create (same txn, private create ticket) initializes not_required -> pending/not_required;
     -- any other change (e.g. -> approved) is a financial decision and stays denied while pending.
     OR (NEW.financial_approval_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.financial_approval_status
         AND NOT (platform_private.has_ticket('c2_external_order_create',NEW.partner_id)
                  AND OLD.financial_approval_status='not_required' AND NEW.financial_approval_status IN ('pending','not_required'))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2_ACCOUNTING_PENDING' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

    WHEN (entity_type = 'accounts_receivable_installments'::text) THEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1

    WHEN (entity_type = 'accounts_payable_installments'::text) THEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1

    WHEN (entity_type = 'receivable_payments'::text) THEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1

    WHEN (entity_type = 'payable_payments'::text) THEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1

    WHEN (entity_type = 'financial_documents'::text) THEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1

    WHEN (entity_type = 'financial_receipts'::text) THEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1

    WHEN (entity_type = 'fiscal_invoices'::text) THEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1

CASE
